overall_notes: Paper focuses on evaluating bias robustness through self-debate generation and stance shifting. The NLG aspect involves generating debate arguments between LLM instances. While quantitative metrics are used, they are not traditional NLG evaluation metrics like BLEU/ROUGE but rather measure bias/stance shifts. Human evaluation compares human vs. LLM persuadability on sociopolitical topics.
